statements.status_notes: joi 18.2.1 is below the 18.2.5 fix for prototype pollution in custom message compilation. The issue is only reachable when untrusted input is passed into schema-construction message configuration, and yarn resolutions that would move this copy to 18.2.5 fail on the OpenSearch Dashboards dependency tree. The bundled version stays at 18.2.1 until upstream ships a compatible update.

joi 18.2.1 is below the 18.2.4 fix for prototype pollution in object().rename() when a schema uses a regular-expression source, a Joi expression target, and multiple:true. Yarn resolutions that would move this copy to a fixed 18.x release fail on the OpenSearch Dashboards dependency tree, so the bundled version stays at 18.2.1 until upstream ships a compatible update.
